name: Figlet
summary: An AI relationship coach built by a practising therapist, with free first messages and two clearly priced subscriptions.
description: Figlet (Figlet by Empathi) is AI relationship coaching software grounded in Emotionally Focused Therapy, built by Figs O’Sullivan, LMFT. The site states it is coaching, not therapy, and is not related to the FIGlet ASCII banner tool. Official subscribe page: first messages are free, no credit card required to start. You can cancel anytime. A “Team Us” figure mentioned elsewhere on the marketing site was not used, because it was not part of this complete subscribe ladder.

pricing.details: First messages free, no card. Back Pocket 18 €/month or 131 €/year; In Your Hand 51 €/month or 176 €/year (250 messages/month, plus a shareable report). Cancel anytime.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: EFT-grounded relationship coaching (the site states it is coaching, not therapy)
